# 数据库参考

SQLite 文件位于 Electron `userData/prism.db`，WAL 模式。本文件直接抽取建表语句，共 **10** 张表；语义与迁移说明见 `docs/architecture/data-model.md`。

源码：[database.ts](../../electron/database.ts)

## 表

### `resources`

```sql
id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
url TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
```

### `tags`

```sql
id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
```

### `resource_tags`

```sql
resource_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
tag_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (resource_id, tag_id),
FOREIGN KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tags(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
```

### `notes`

```sql
id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
vault_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
title TEXT NOT NULL,
content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
modified_at TEXT NOT NULL
```

### `settings`

```sql
key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
value TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
```

### `gtd_projects`

```sql
id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
title TEXT NOT NULL,
description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
archived_at TEXT
```

### `gtd_tasks`

```sql
id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
title TEXT NOT NULL,
notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
project_id INTEGER,
scheduled_date TEXT,
due_date TEXT,
completed_at TEXT,
created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES gtd_projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
```

### `gtd_project_folders`

```sql
project_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
vault_path TEXT NOT NULL,
folder_path TEXT NOT NULL,
created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES gtd_projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
```

### `gtd_project_links`

```sql
id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('note','canvas')),
vault_path TEXT NOT NULL,
file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
title TEXT NOT NULL,
created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
UNIQUE (project_id, file_path),
FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES gtd_projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
```

### `pdf_documents`

```sql
id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
repo_path TEXT NOT NULL,
path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
rel_path TEXT NOT NULL,
title TEXT NOT NULL,
page_count INTEGER,
file_size INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
modified_at TEXT NOT NULL,
cover_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
cover_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
cover_custom INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
cover_dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
added_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
```
